description: Laplace distribution survival function 1 - e^z / 2 (z < 0), e^-z / 2 (z >= 0), z = (x - mu) / b (location mu, scale b)

tolerance.reason: the mirror image of laplace_cdf (Q(x) = F(2 mu - x)), with the same exact z and the same rounding. 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)

grid: the laplace_cdf grid: (mu, b) in {(0, 1), (0, 2^-500), (0, 2^500), (-10, 1/4), (100, 8), (-2^1023, 2^1023)} x x = mu + b z for z = -40..40 step 1/4, z = +-{50, 100, 200, 500, 700, 707, 708, 709, 710, 720, 740, 744, 745, 746, 800, 1000, 1e5, 1e10, 1e100, 1e300} and z = +-2^-30, +-2^-60, kept where x is an exact, finite double that is 0 or normal (so z = (x - mu) / b is exact); Q rounds to 1 below about z = -36.7, is subnormal from about z = 707.7 and 0 above about z = 744.4
